title: OmniSource normalized app record
description: Centralized schema for the normalized per-app record consumed by the OmniSource website and OmniStore Pro clients (feeds/api/v2/apps.json and feeds/api/v2/apps/<id>.json). AltStore distribution feeds keep their own shape (schemas/altstore-feed.schema.json); this schema is the stable client contract. The pipeline enforces it in src/omnisource/app_schema.py and the build fails when a record violates it.

id.description: Stable catalog slug; globally unique within the feed.

bundleIdentifier.description: On-device identity. Unique unless the catalog declares an alternativeTo group (e.g. YouTube tweaks).

version.description: Newest distributable version. Must contain at least one digit and no whitespace.

description.description: Long description. Falls back to subtitle/name so the field is never missing.

icon.description: Absolute icon URL. Never empty: missing icons resolve to the placeholder asset.

screenshots.description: Screenshot URLs. The field is always present; it may be empty when the app ships none.

source.description: Upstream identity (e.g. owner/repo or feed host).

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the newest asset, or null when the upstream publishes none.
